title: CCD2 Annex III APRC Recompute
description: Recomputes the EU Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (CCD2) annual percentage rate of charge (APRC) from a caller-supplied drawdown/repayment schedule against Annex III Part I's basic equation, solved by bracketed bisection for the rate X. Reports converged, bracketed, iterations_used and residual_at_convergence as honesty fields alongside aprc_pct, rounded to at least one decimal place per Annex III Part I remark (d), half-up on the next digit. Verify-only: does not determine CCD2 applicability and does not assert compliance.

drawdowns.description: Array of drawdown flows. Each: {amount, full_periods, fraction} where full_periods is a whole count of years and fraction is a fraction of a year in [0,1) since the first drawdown (Annex III Part I's t_k), or the shorthand {amount, t_years}. At least one drawdown at t=0 is expected by Annex III Part I remark (b).

repayments.description: Array of repayment/charge flows, same {amount, full_periods, fraction} or {amount, t_years} shape as drawdowns (Annex III Part I's D_l/s_l).

mcp_tool_definition.name: recompute_ccd2_aprc_annex3
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes the CCD2 Directive (EU) 2023/2225 Annex III APRC from a drawdown/repayment schedule by bracketed bisection on Annex III Part I's present-value-equality equation. Returns aprc_pct (rounded per Annex III Part I remark (d)), converged, bracketed, iterations_used, residual_at_convergence. Reports non-convergence honestly rather than guessing. Verify-only, no compliance determination.

drawdowns.description: Array of {amount, full_periods, fraction} or {amount, t_years}

repayments.description: Array of {amount, full_periods, fraction} or {amount, t_years}
